basic_info.description: Rarely available 2BED+DEN/2.5 BATH townhome at coveted Chelsea Park in Mission Dolores! A flexible floorplan, exclusive-use garden terrace, and numerous custom upgrades combine to create a distinct city home that truly checks all the boxes. Chef's kitchen with honed granite countertops, M8 cabinetry, Bertazzoni range, and SS refrigerator. 2 spacious en-suite bedrooms on upper level with vaulted ceilings and lux spa-like bathrooms finished with Italian marble surrounds. Flexible mezzanine Bonus room can cross-function as 3rd Bdrm or home office. Additional features include guest powder room, abundant closets, hardwood floors on both levels, fresh paint throughout, full-size stacked washer/dryer, 1-car dedicated parking & onsite bike storage. Triple-mint location in burgeoning Mission Dolores near Dolores Park, one block to Tartine, BiRite, world-class dining, cafes, and retail. Easy access to MUNI, BART, shuttles, 280/101, Downtown, and South Bay. Near-perfect 99 Walk & Bike Score!
